execution.detail: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (migrations/001_index.sql:2) runs inside a transaction block, where PostgreSQL rejects it, so the migration fails (see risk/concurrently-in-transaction).

message: New index orders_status_idx on existing table orders (status) (postgres). A non-CONCURRENT CREATE INDEX takes a SHARE lock that blocks writes for the duration of the build.
mitigation: Use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (and DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY for rollback) in postgres.

message: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY orders_status_idx runs inside a transaction block (migrations/001_index.sql:2). PostgreSQL cannot run CONCURRENTLY in a transaction, so the migration fails.
mitigation: Run the statement outside BEGIN/COMMIT; when the migration tool wraps each file in a transaction, move it to its own file and turn the wrapping off for that file.
